build_CenterRegionAssigner: build a CenterRegionAssigner instance with pos_scale and neg_scale thresholds for object detection training
run_assign_method: run the assign method on pred_instances and gt_instances to get AssignResult with positive and negative labels
test_scale_boxes: test the scale_boxes function to expand bounding boxes by a given scale factor
review_is_located_in: review the is_located_in function that checks if points are located within bounding boxes
summarize_bboxes_area: summarize the bboxes_area function that computes the area of an array of bounding boxes
